releaseNotes:
✨ What's New in Release v2.1.82:
- 🛡️ Zero-Dependency Deep Re-Indexer: restore drive catalogs directly from Telegram channel history
- 🔍 Rename-Proof Content Fingerprinting: duplicate-proof backup even if files or folders are moved
- ⚡ Delta Cloud Sync & Batch API: sub-second cloud sync with 95% reduced data usage
- 🧹 "Free Up Phone Space" 1-Tap Assistant: safely reclaim gigabytes while preserving cloud copies
- 🎛️ Smart Multi-Facet Filter Bar & 4x/3x/2x/1x dynamic grid layout switch
- ⚡ Animated Shimmer Skeletons for 60 FPS zero-flicker photo & video browsing
- ✨ Floating Glass Bulk Action Bar with 1-tap download, share, and trash actions
- 🔐 Hardware-Backed Android Keystore Master Vault for AES-256 key protection
